description: Validation of the maximum Werner-composed-fidelity path search. Under w=(4F-1)/3 the swap composition is an exact product (w12=w1*w2), so an exact additive shortest-path formulation with weights -log w exists; -log F is the proxy that does NOT preserve optimality. Checks: (1) the substitution identity; (2) agreement between the oracle's Dijkstra-like relaxation and a -log w shortest path on the paper's own 100-city instance; (3) agreement of both with exhaustive enumeration on small random graphs.
